title: Even I’m Getting Nervous
speaker: Meet Kevin (Kevin Paffrath)

macro_themes.view: Rising rental rates on A100/H100/GB200 chips in 2026 refute the depreciation-cliff and capex-recycling bear case.

macro_themes.theme: Labor market is the real risk
macro_themes.view: Rising Black unemployment and AI-driven job losses are the canary; when labor rolls over, capex funding and stocks fall.
Soft labor data and stable inflation expectations mean likely only one hike this year; no December hike expected.
Oracle's net income is rising and Nebius is profitable ex-depreciation; CoreWeave is weak.

calls.condition: Expects a euphoric rally after an Iran deal; beyond ~1 year, a rolling-over labor market would end the bull case.
calls.reason: AI capex is accelerating, not recycling: GPU rental rates for old and new chips rising in 2026 and ASML backlog exploding; Fed likely to hike less.
calls.quote: I actually think we're going to see a giant euphoric rally in the stock market post an Iran deal... for the next probably at least year, I'm actually really bullish

notes: Date inferred from host saying the Oct 30 coupon expires 'in about 9 days' (= Oct 21); listing approx 2026-10-22. Long-term bullish applies to roughly the next year; he expects trouble after that once labor rolls over. No price levels given.
